roles.description: Owns C1 and C3; approves constitution changes.
Owns C2 (refund authority); proposes changes to refund parameters.
May approve a refund above T (C2).
Customer service: enters amends and cancels on a customer's behalf.
Answers E8 fraud reviews (E8 SPEC-E R2.2).
The service principal the order workflow runs as; applies effects.
A shop customer acting through the customer portal.

principals.description: Customer-service team lead (also a finance approver: a dual role)

bounds.statement: Group policy: no refund above EUR 1,000.00 leaves any entity without an approval. An entity rule may set a lower threshold, never a higher one.

clauses.title: Conservation and exactly-once money movement
clauses.statement: Per order and fulfilment: the amount captured less the amount refunded equals what the customer owes for what the workflow delivered (zero for a fulfilment it set failed or cancelled; the charge for one it set completed); a refund never exceeds the captures it returns; a fulfilment is charged at most once, with one idempotency key per logical charge, for the amount of the edition in force at placement.

evidence.what: every committed charge and refund attempt with key, fulfilment and amount
evidence.source: host journal: ledger rows joined to effect.emit

evidence.what: each fulfilment's outcome as the workflow set it

clauses.title: Refund authority with separation of duties
clauses.statement: A refund whose amount is above T (parameter refundApprovalThresholdMinor of the version pinned for the order) is applied only after a principal holding finance-approver approves it in a refundApproval task whose subject is the fulfilment and whose question states the amount; the approver must not be a principal who entered an amend or a cancel of the order.

exceptions.when: no valid finance approval after three requests for the same refund

evidence.what: the approval task, bound to the fulfilment (subject) and the refund amount
the answer and the approving principal
the approver's roles under the pinned version
the principals who entered an amend or cancel of the order
the hold and release of the refund, with clause id and constitution hash
evidence.source: host journal: port decisions in call rows

clauses.title: Change control and pinning
clauses.statement: The constitution changes only by a new version proposed by a holder of finance or controller and approved, before its effectiveFrom, by a holder of controller under the version in force who is not the proposer; every parameter stays within the bounds of higher layers. Every run is pinned to the hash of the version in force at its order's placement and journals that hash with every governed decision.

exceptions.when: a change that cannot wait for a second principal (declared, not exercised in OT-0)

evidence.what: every version with proposer, approvals and the gate decision (in force, refused, reasons)
the constitution hash pinned for each run
evidence.source: host journal: decisions.constitution.pins in call rows
